claim_kind: additional set-theoretic axiom scheme, not a theorem of ZFC
canonical_statement: For every cardinal kappa smaller than the continuum, MA(kappa) asserts that for every nonempty partially ordered set satisfying the countable chain condition and every family D of at most kappa dense subsets, there is a filter in the poset meeting every member of D.
domain_and_universes: Set-theoretic cardinals kappa, the continuum 2^aleph_0, nonempty ccc partial orders, indexed families of dense subsets, and filters on those orders. A Lean universe/set-theory representation is not selected at intake.
ordered_quantifiers: a nonempty partially ordered set P satisfying ccc
an index type I with cardinality at most kappa
a family D : I -> Set P of dense subsets
hypotheses: P satisfies the countable chain condition
the family of dense sets has cardinality at most kappa
each D_i is dense in P
kappa is strictly smaller than the continuum
conclusion: There exists a filter G on P such that G intersects D_i for every i.
convention_choices: The orientation of the forcing order and the corresponding upward/downward closure convention for filters must be fixed together.
The ccc condition may be stated by countability of antichains or by the absence of uncountable antichains; any credited transport must be checked.
MA may be encoded as the family of propositions MA(kappa) for all kappa below the continuum or as one bundled proposition; exact equivalence must be checked.
excluded_or_distinct_claims: Martin's axiom is not claimed to be provable in ZFC.
MA plus not-CH is a stronger theory and is not silently identified with MA.
The consistency of MA or MA plus not-CH relative to ZFC is a metamathematical theorem distinct from the axiom itself.
The proper forcing axiom and Martin's maximum are stronger forcing axioms and are outside this target.
The source phrase 'axiomatization of forcing' is not itself an exact proposition.
degenerate_and_boundary_cases: Finite or countable families of dense sets, empty index families, trivial posets, kappa equal to the continuum, and order-dual conventions must be tested explicitly. The strict bound kappa < continuum must not be weakened to kappa <= continuum.

alternate_encodings.target: the dense-set statement indexed by a type I with #I < continuum

foundation_profile: Open. The object-level axiom must be separated from any metatheoretic consistency claim; classical logic, choice, cardinal arithmetic, and the ambient set-theory model require an explicit versioned profile.
tcb_profile: Lean 4 kernel plus pinned mathlib is intended; the set-theory encoding, exact toolchain inputs, imports, and transitive dependency closure remain open.
computation_profile: No computation, forcing oracle, model checker, or external solver is credited at intake.
formal_system: Lean 4 with pinned dependencies after an object-level or model-theoretic encoding is selected
source_revisions: Repository source wording and discovery bibliography are crosswalked in source_statement_crosswalk.md. Immutable primary-source copies, pinpoint pages, errata review, and independent source acceptance remain open.

open_task_dag.task: Pin and inspect the Martin-Solovay primary source and distinguish the definition of MA from its relative-consistency and consequence theorems
Freeze the forcing-order, filter, dense-set, ccc, cardinal, and continuum conventions
Choose whether the formal target is the object-level MA proposition under explicit set-theory primitives or a model-theoretic satisfaction statement
Elaborate the exact Lean target and mutation-test the cardinal bound, ccc condition, density, filter law, and binder scope

freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on a change to the selected claim kind, forcing/filter/cardinal conventions, source pin, formal target, toolchain/dependencies, trust profile, or rev-5.6 standard.
status_boundary: This planned intake identifies Martin's axiom as an additional axiom rather than a ZFC theorem and freezes its standard defining family only. It does not assert MA, prove its consistency, select an exact Lean encoding, or accept the repository's untrusted 'verified' label.
